# OptimalX design constraints (read before any direction work)

Date: 2026-09-17. Conductor: the session model. This file collects the binding facts every designer and builder must respect. Sources: the repo at C:\Users\Ahmed\OneDrive\Desktop\optimalx (BUILD.md, tokens.css, tailwind.config.cjs), the engine surface report (scratchpad/engine-surface.md), the research files (scratchpad/research/*.md), the 39 reference boards in references/, and the owner's brief.

## The owner's brief (verbatim intent)
- Final, absolutely deployment-ready storefront for the owner's own Salla store (not marketplace).
- Storefront is LIGHT mode; dark is complementary only (bands, hero, footer).
- Premium identity that reflects the logo; Saudi-market audience; maximum conversion, user experience and user journey; integrate the best of iHerb and bodybuilding.com logic; brand persona: the knowledgeable local shop that explains things properly, never oversells.
- Arabic first, Modern Standard Arabic in published copy (no dialect, no diacritics), English secondary.
- The owner will generate images and videos on request: list exactly what to generate, with dimensions and art direction.

## The logo
references/OptimalX_logo.png: lowercase black wordmark "optimal" (geometric grotesque, tight tracking), an orange mark of two chevron arrows forming an X (angled about 22 degrees from vertical, sharp mitred corners, no rounded terminals), and the tagline "NUTRITION & WELLNESS" in spaced small caps between two rules. Brand colour in the dashboard: #EE4D22 (this is the value the engine injects at runtime; do not change it).

## Platform facts that bind the design
1. Colour: the engine sets --color-primary, --color-primary-dark/-light/-reverse on <html> inline after hydration from the dashboard brand colour (#EE4D22). tokens.css must define the same values as first-paint fallbacks. Everything else (ground, ink, lines, semantic, spacing, radii, shadows) is ours in app/styles/tokens.css.
2. Font: Cairo is the dashboard font (Google link injected, weights 300/400/700). The repo also self-hosts Cairo variable (200-1000) in public/assets/fonts. Design with Cairo weights 400/600/700/800; the build will move to the self-hosted variable file and the owner will switch the dashboard font to custom. One family only; Latin glyphs from Cairo. Western numerals for prices and counts.
3. Radius: tailwind borderRadius.DEFAULT is 8px and styles the engine's own s-product-card and s-button-element too (content globs scan the engine dist). Scale in use: 6 / 8 / pill. Do not introduce a fourth radius without a reason.
4. Components: 126 salla-* web components render in LIGHT DOM (only salla-hook and one bundle modal use shadow DOM), so our CSS reaches inside them via their s-* classes (1888-class safelist). Native components we compose, never rebuild: product card (engine ProductCard, overridable at registry key product:card), product options, quantity input, add-to-cart button, quick buy, installment (tabby/tamara), delivery promise, wishlist, social share, rating stars, reviews/comments, bought-together, trust badges, filters, infinite scroll, breadcrumb, slider (Swiper), tabs, accordion (collapsible), modal, booking field, datetime picker, loyalty, cart summary, payments icons, apps icons, contacts, social, menu, search, user menu, localization modal, offer modal, scopes, file upload, conditional fields, gifting, advertisement bar.
5. Layout seam: Header, Footer, MainMenu, MobileMenu are engine components, replaceable only by passing our own layout to TwilightProvider. We WILL do that: OptimalX ships its own Header (search-first, goal navigation, mega menu) and Footer (trust line with CR/VAT/Maroof placeholders, payment marks), composed around the engine's login/scopes/offer modals. Design both.
6. Home page: the merchant composes home blocks in the dashboard from the theme's declared components; the theme must also render a complete default composition when nothing is configured. Design the home as ordered blocks, each a self-contained component with merchant-editable fields (image, title, text, links, products).
7. Money: SAR renders as the Saudi riyal symbol icon (sicon-sar) next to the amount. Prices are VAT inclusive.
8. Locale: on a bilingual store URLs are /ar/... and /en/...; RTL is the default direction; logical CSS properties only; directional icons mirror; Arabic body line-height 1.7 or higher; Arabic body text never below 15px or weight 400.
9. Icons: UI chrome icons come from sallaicons (sicon-*) which the native components already load. A custom inline SVG sprite exists only for category and trust icons (protein, vitamins, minerals, creatine, omega, pre-workout, beauty, daily health, authenticity, expiry, plan, points, gift, referral): mitred joins, square caps, 1.8px stroke, one orange fill element per icon, no rounded terminals.
10. SSR: an open engine defect discards the server tree on every page (React #418); the first paint is a skeleton for several seconds on slow 4G. Design skeletons that match final layout (no CLS), and do not rely on entrance animations for meaning.
11. Mobile render budget (binding, from mastermind-audit/references/mobile-render-budget.md): glows are radial gradients never filter: blur(); backdrop-filter rationed (never behind a fill at 0.90 alpha or more, never on per-item elements, never on position: fixed, at most about 30 per route); no permanent will-change / translateZ(0); no filter on an ancestor of background-clip: text; no fixed full-viewport decoration; fixed panels stay inside the viewport; every horizontal scroller is position: relative; html and body background equal the route ground; nothing widens the document.
12. Motion (BUILD.md 3.4): composition carries the energy, motion confirms that something happened. Add to cart: label to tick, cart count bumps once, toast, 160ms. Variant change: price cross-fade, image swap, 120ms, no layout shift. Accordion and filter: height ease-out 180ms. Sticky bar: slide up 280ms when the buy button scrolls past. Card hover: border colour only, no lift. Loading: skeletons never spinners. Scroll reveals: not used. prefers-reduced-motion honoured on everything.
13. The angle (BUILD.md 3.3): the logo chevron is a 22-degree system used structurally: one angled band edge per major section, one wedge per screen, large and quiet; never on small elements, never rotation on text, equal card heights everywhere; borders and dividers straight. Browse versus buy: heroes, editorial bands, goal pages, branch page and campaigns carry the angle; listing grids, product page, cart, checkout and account are conventional white cards, equal heights, square-ish corners, no clip-path.
14. Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): 44px tap targets, visible focus ring everywhere, --ox-accent only for large text and UI (body copy in ink), one h1 per page, real landmarks, skip link, labels bound to inputs, empty and error states designed in Arabic with a way out.
15. Claims: no invented statistics, no health-outcome or treatment or weight-loss promises, no professional titles, no competitor names in copy. Trust is shown by specifics (which city, which day, which branch, real counts once they exist).

## Existing token proposal (BUILD.md 3.1, a starting point, not a cage)
Ground --ox-paper #F7F7F8, card #FFFFFF, ink #17171A, ink-2 #5A5A61, ink-3 #8A8A93, line #E6E6E9, line-2 #D2D2D8. Semantic: go #0F7B4F / #E8F4EE, note #9A6A12 / #FBF2E0, stop #B3261E / #FBEAE8. Space 4px base (4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64). Type: display 32-44/700/-0.035em/1.05; h2 24/700/-0.025em/1.15; h3 17/700/1.4; body 15/400/1.7; small 13/400/1.6; micro 11.5/700/1.5.

## What the references converge on (the 39 boards)
A light neutral ground; a graphite hero band with an athlete photo and one large orange wedge; a 4-item trust strip under the hero (authentic, fast shipping, secure payment, support); "shop by goal" as six equal cards with line icons; category tiles with product photography; bestseller product cards on white with a solid orange add-to-cart; a dark "expert services" band with three channel cards; guides/articles cards; a Medina branch block with storefront photo, hours and map; newsletter; dark footer with trust line. The cleanest boards are references/ChatGPT Image Sep 16, 2026, 10_04_02 PM.png and 09_59_06 PM.png (systematic, light) and the Firefly boards with the angular hero (e.g. "648492.png", "803149.png"). The English Firefly boards with invented statistics ("100+ plans, 98%") show what NOT to do.
